{
  "name": "proposal-kit",
  "private": true,
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "type": "module",
  "description": "A tiny design system for one solar proposal summary, built so an AI coding tool can't make the costly mistakes quietly. Made-up data.",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "vite",
    "build": "tsc -b && vite build",
    "typecheck": "tsc -b",
    "lint": "eslint .",
    "tokens": "node scripts/check-tokens.mjs",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "check": "npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run tokens && npm run test",
    "storybook": "storybook dev -p 6006",
    "build-storybook": "storybook build -o storybook-static"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@radix-ui/react-separator": "1.2.0",
    "@radix-ui/react-slot": "1.5.0",
    "class-variance-authority": "0.7.1",
    "clsx": "2.1.1",
    "lucide-react": "1.63.0",
    "react": "19.3.1",
    "react-dom": "19.3.1",
    "tailwind-merge": "3.7.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@eslint/js": "10.0.1",
    "@storybook/addon-a11y": "10.6.5",
    "@storybook/addon-docs": "10.6.5",
    "@storybook/react-vite": "10.6.5",
    "@tailwindcss/vite": "4.3.3",
    "@testing-library/dom": "10.4.2",
    "@testing-library/jest-dom": "7.0.1",
    "@testing-library/react": "16.3.3",
    "@types/node": "24.19.2",
    "@types/react": "19.3.0",
    "@types/react-dom": "19.3.0",
    "@vitejs/plugin-react": "6.1.2",
    "axe-core": "4.14.0",
    "eslint": "10.13.0",
    "globals": "17.13.0",
    "jsdom": "30.1.3",
    "storybook": "10.6.5",
    "tailwindcss": "4.3.3",
    "typescript": "6.0.3",
    "typescript-eslint": "8.72.1",
    "vite": "8.3.5",
    "vitest": "4.1.12",
    "vitest-axe": "0.1.0"
  }
}

import { CircleCheck } from "lucide-react"; import { Money } from "@/components/Money"; import { PaymentLine } from "@/components/PaymentLine"; import { SavingsEstimate, type SavingsAssumptions } from "@/components/SavingsEstimate"; import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge"; import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card"; import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator"; /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */ /* Proposal data. All money is in whole cents. */ /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */ const proposal = { id: "P-2077", preparedOn: { iso: "2026-11-12", display: "November 12, 2026" }, status: "Ready to sign", installer: "Brightline Home Solar", homeowner: { name: "Maria Okafor", address: "77 Juniper Bend, Lakeport", }, system: { panelCount: 18, panelWatts: 410, inverter: "One microinverter per panel", annualKwh: 11_900, }, price: { lineItems: [ { label: "Panels and inverters", cents: 1_395_000 }, { label: "Installation", cents: 645_000 }, { label: "Permits and inspection", cents: 160_000 }, ], downPaymentCents: 200_000, }, loan: { apr: 6.49, termMonths: 240, monthlyCents: 14_900, }, savings: { ratePerKwhCents: 15, yearlyIncreasePct: 3, years: 25, }, } as const; /* Derived figures, so the totals on the page always add up from the lines above. */ const systemKw = (proposal.system.panelCount * proposal.system.panelWatts) / 1000; const totalPriceCents = proposal.price.lineItems.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.cents, 0); // $22,000 const amountFinancedCents = totalPriceCents - proposal.price.downPaymentCents; // $20,000 const totalOfPaymentsCents = proposal.loan.monthlyCents * proposal.loan.termMonths; // $35,760 const interestCents = totalOfPaymentsCents - amountFinancedCents; // $15,760 const savingsAssumptions: SavingsAssumptions = { annualKwh: proposal.system.annualKwh, ratePerKwhCents: proposal.savings.ratePerKwhCents, yearlyIncreasePct: proposal.savings.yearlyIncreasePct, years: proposal.savings.years, }; const kwFormat = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }); const intFormat = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }); /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */ function Row({ label, children, strong = false }: { label: string; children: React.ReactNode; strong?: boolean }) { return (
{label}
{children}
); } export default function GeneratedSummary() { const { homeowner, system, price, loan } = proposal; return (
{/* Header */}

{proposal.installer} · Proposal {proposal.id}

{proposal.status}

Solar proposal for {homeowner.name}

{homeowner.address} · Prepared {proposal.preparedOn.display}

{/* System */}

Your system

 {system.panelCount} panels at {intFormat.format(system.panelWatts)} W each
{kwFormat.format(systemKw)} kW {system.panelCount} × {intFormat.format(system.panelWatts)} W {system.inverter} {intFormat.format(system.annualKwh)} kWh a year
{/* Price */}

Price
{price.lineItems.map((item) => ( ))}
{/* Financing */}

Financing

 Loan on the amount financed
{/* Savings */}

Estimated savings
); }

I wrote the page to `src/views/GeneratedSummary.tsx`. I couldn't run commands, so it hasn't been type-checked, linted, tested or viewed in a browser. Running `npm run check` would cover the first three.

**What's on the page**
- **Header:** installer, proposal P-2077, a "Ready to sign" badge (with text and an icon, not just color), the homeowner's name and address, and the prepared date.
- **Your system:** 7.38 kW, 18 × 410 W panels, one microinverter per panel, and the estimated production of 11,900 kWh a year.

**How it's built**
- All the data sits at the top of the file. Money is stored in whole cents and every dollar amount on the page goes through `<Money>`.

- I checked the math by hand: 18 × 410 W = 7.38 kW, and a $20,000 loan at 6.49% for 240 months comes to about $149.00 a month.
- There are no hex colors or px values in the file, which keeps it in line with the repo's tokens-only rule.
